description: Update the toast notification system to properly handle error messages containing multiple colons. Currently, messages with multiple colons get truncated after the second colon, losing important error context. Implement a solution that splits only on the first colon to preserve the complete error message.
functional_requirements: Modify the error message parsing logic to split only on the first occurrence of a colon
Preserve the full message content after the first colon in toast notifications
Maintain backward compatibility with existing error message formats that use single colons
Update any relevant test cases to verify the new behavior with messages containing multiple colons
